summary: Provision Confluence space, Slack onboarding channel, and Jira template for Model Evaluation team
description:
Issue summary: The newly formed Model Evaluation (ModelEval) group needs a standardized collaboration surface and light automation to support onboarding, evaluation runs, and result review cycles.

Impact: Without a dedicated Confluence space, Slack channel, and Jira template, onboarding is fragmented (documents in personal spaces, ad-hoc channels), causing delays for new evaluators and inconsistent tracking of evaluation tickets. This affects time-to-first-eval and introduces risk for auditability of eval artifacts.

Request details / acceptance criteria:
- Create a Confluence space named 'ModelEval - Redwood' with page templates for: Evaluation Plan, Run Results (table + attachments), Postmortem / Regression Notes, and a reuseable 'Eval Checklist' macro. Space permissions: ModelEval-admins (edit), ModelEval-members (view/comment/edit where appropriate). Restricted pages for PII or partner data set notes.
- Provision a Slack channel #modeleval-onboarding (private) with pinned onboarding playbook, and a Slack workflow that triggers a welcome message and links checklist when a new member is added. Add integrations: Confluence page previews and GitHub notifications.
- Create a Jira project (Team-managed) called 'ModelEval OPS' with a ticket type template 'Evaluation Run' that pre-populates fields: model_version, dataset_id, eval_type (regression|smoke|bias), expected_duration, owner, linked_confluence_page. Include an automation rule: when an 'Evaluation Run' moves to 'Done', auto-create a Confluence 'Run Results' page and attach the Jira ticket link.
- Automations: Slack workflow for onboarding; Jira -> Confluence automation as above; add a webhook to notify #modeleval-notifications on run completion.
- IAM: Add group 'ModelEval-admins' and 'ModelEval-members' in SSO (SCIM) mapping, and ensure Confluence and Slack groups sync.
- Compliance: Flag pages that hold partner datasets and ensure 'restricted' permission template is available.

Steps to reproduce / how to validate:
1) New hire added to ModelEval-members should receive Slack welcome DM with checklist (verify within 5 minutes).
2) Creating an 'Evaluation Run' issue should generate a linked Confluence page after marking Done.
3) Only ModelEval-admins can delete pages or change space-level permissions.
4) Notifications appear in #modeleval-notifications on run completion.

Related artifacts requested: initial page tree skeleton, templates exported as HTML or storage format, Slack workflow JSON, and Jira automation rule export.

Urgency: Medium — team has 3 people onboarding over the next 3 weeks and would benefit from standardized workspace before run cycles start.

Notes and constraints: We must avoid granting broad org-wide 'confluence-administrators' rights; prefer group-based permissions. Coordinate with Security for dataset-restriction tags. If SCIM provisioning is blocked, provide manual add instructions and a fallback automation for invites.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Maya Chen: Opening request — happy to provide initial templates. Please advise expected ETA and whether SCIM mapping is required.
2026-03-10 - Devon Patel: Acknowledged. Can you confirm naming convention for pages and whether external contractors need access? Also: do we want the Slack channel private or public?

2026-03-11 - Maya Chen: Confirm private channel. External contractors may need scoped access for certain projects — we'll provide list. Naming convention: 'ModelEval - <page name>' for space pages. We prefer automatic Confluence page creation when Jira run completes.

2026-03-11 - Security (Sofia Alvarez): Please add a requirement to flag any pages containing partner dataset identifiers as 'restricted' and notify security for onboarding. We will need an owner for approvals.

2026-03-12 - Devon Patel: Provisioning plan: 1) create Confluence space skeleton and templates (ETA 3 business days), 2) create Jira project and evaluation template (ETA 4 business days), 3) Slack channel + workflow (ETA 2 business days), 4) SCIM group mapping pending identity team (blocking for automatic sync). Marking Triage until SCIM confirmed.
workaround: In absence of SCIM mapping, create manual invite flow and a pinned Confluence page with onboarding instructions. Create a lightweight repository with checklist templates until automation is in place.
